title: Logs
description: Record logs in Zelos, on the same timeline as your data: a device's or this computer's system log, any log file, or any command's output.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One entry for each log to record. Auto-configure adds this computer's system log.

read.title: Log
read.description: The system log is where the operating system and its services log. It is the journal or syslog on Linux, the unified log on macOS, and the event log on Windows.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the signal tree. Empty names it after the device, and the file or command it reads. Letters, digits, spaces, _ and -.

host.title: Address
host.description: The device's address, as you'd type after ssh, such as me@my-board. Pick one from your SSH config, or type it.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: Empty uses your SSH config, or 22.

key_path.title: Key file
key_path.description: A private key to use instead of your SSH agent, your default keys and the key from Show Access Key.

host_key_policy.title: Host key check
host_key_policy.description: Trust any key keeps working after a device is reflashed. Check known_hosts refuses a key it does not know.

ssh_options.title: Extra ssh options
ssh_options.description: Added to the ssh command, such as -J bastion for a jump host.

history.title: Earlier lines
history.description: Also records what was logged before you started, where the log keeps it. That is the journal and the kernel's lines dmesg prints, as far back as Zelos keeps data; files, logread, and the system log of a Mac or a PC start at new lines.

values.title: Numbers as signals
values.description: Turns numbers a line prints, such as rpm=1450, into signals you can plot. Automatic leaves out system logs and the kernel's lines, which print settings, not measurements.

history.title: Earlier lines
history.description: Also records what was logged before you started, where the log keeps it. That is the journal and the kernel's lines dmesg prints, as far back as Zelos keeps data; files, logread, and the system log of a Mac or a PC start at new lines.

values.title: Numbers as signals
values.description: Turns numbers a line prints, such as rpm=1450, into signals you can plot. Automatic leaves out system logs and the kernel's lines, which print settings, not measurements.

path.title: File
path.description: The file's path, such as /var/log/app.log. Rotation keeps working.

command.title: Command
command.description: A command that keeps printing lines, such as dmesg -w or adb logcat. Over SSH it runs on the device.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Every source shows under it, as in Logs/bench_1.

log_level.title: Extension log level
log_level.description: How much Logs reports about itself; it never filters the lines it records.
